syllabus_topics: Types of structural analysis (static, dynamic, linear, non-linear, instability, vibration)
Concept of non-linearity and limit load
Obtaining critical loads and instability modes
Effect of shear deformation on the behavior of structures
Verification of structural safety in non-linear static regime
Verification of structural safety in dynamic regime
assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of two MAP45 exams, each covering one chapter and counting for 50%. It is only allowed to consult theoretical notes (in Portuguese) during these exams. It is possible to improve one or both MAPs on the specified revision date.
bibliography: Silvestre N. e Araújo A., "Apontamentos de Mecânica Estrutural - Capítulo 1: Sistemas Discretos", Instituto Superior Técnico, Universidade de Lisboa, 2014 (main)
